Review [#415](history/sessions/415/45abdf6845707de2f731a2b2cd1d2f919034aa1edd9cb7afbf3141e24ab6575b.md) found two bypasses in both checkers.
Shortened reason comparisons and skipped self-tests passed incorrectly.
I saved a [fix script](../execution/scripts/fix_reason_controls_415.py) and one [order](orders.json) for fix round 2.
The script checks source hashes, preserves existing controls, and checks completed control counts.
Two runs in a temporary copy passed. All eight bypass probes failed with the expected messages.
The second run changed no bytes. Repository checkers remain unchanged until the ordered task applies the script.
The expected gain is detection of both bypasses before independent review.
Review #415 used the author's model family. Source verification remains incomplete because its prepared source mount was absent.
Native answers, restricted-store readiness, and Owner method acceptance remain unresolved.
Product quality remains unmeasured. Reader implementation remains blocked.

## What next
Apply the saved script, verify the expected hashes in [working memory](../policy/working-memory.md), then independently review both fixes.
Do not repeat specification reviews #408 and #409. Further blocking findings require a new scope after fix round 2.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
